Request flow

flowchart LR
      Browser[Browser] --> API[Review API]

Review persistence model

erDiagram
      SESSION ||--o{ WHITEBOARD : owns
      SESSION ||--o{ FEEDBACK_EVENT : emits
      WHITEBOARD ||--o{ FEEDBACK_EVENT : snapshots
      SESSION {
        string id PK
        string artifact_path
      }
      WHITEBOARD {
        string diagram_id PK
        string source_hash
        json scene
      }
      FEEDBACK_EVENT {
        string event_id PK
        string scene_path
        string preview_path
      }

Batch reply exchange

sequenceDiagram
      participant R as Reviewer
      participant S as Review server
      participant A as Agent
      R->>S: queue five items
      R->>S: send now
      S->>A: one feedback event
      A->>S: one reply, whole batch
      S->>R: batch marked answered
